notes.title: December hotfix
notes.notes: Hey gang, there was a bug causing some people to experience that they could not play the game beyond the title screen. That was my fault, and has now been fixed :D

notes.title: Patch 2.6 is live! The barn doors are open!
notes.notes:
Version [b]2.6.0[/b] is freshly baked and ready to be served.

[h1]Twitch Integration[/h1]
We have been doodling with Twitch integration and while it's still in preview, we are now confident to opening up the doors so everyone can use it. It enables the viewers to not only highlight and help the player, but they can sign up for the game themselves, and have small pixellated versions of their Twitch personas appear in the broadcaster's game.

Remember, if you are playing in NSFW mode, to ensure to the best of your ability that your audience is consenting adults and your stream is marked as Adult Content.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stabilized a lot of Twitch integration elements.
[*] Spectators can now aid the player using the !locate command.
[*] Settings can now be accessed from the Pause menu.
[*] Made some new systems to reduce the number of superfluous statements from guests.
[*] Improved visual depiction of locked in guests.
[*] The Twitch Connect panel, when connected, can also be accessed from the Pause menu.
[*] 3 new streamer cameos from HyperStipherX's auction.
[*] Spectators can now reset their moaning style to a neutral kiss using !kiss.
[*] Twitch broadcaster + mods can now kick/exit other people on the fly using the !exit command.
[*] Revised cleanup-script reduces clutter requests.
[*] Improved the Avatar image to pixel avatar flow.
[*] Cleaned up some activity descriptions.
[*] Fixed bug where the true non-imposter could be detected by position.
[*] Specific rooms can now be blocked.
[*] Fixed some typos.
[/list]

[h1]Seeking streamers on Twitch/YouTube[/h1]
If you or someone you know are sitting with a Twitch/YouTube channel and just yearning for some sweaty sexy collaboration, our campaign over at KeyMailer is actively taking requests. Follow this link to get a free steam key, and let the good times roll:

[url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/d28ca2a7]Orgynizer @ KeyMailer[/url]

notes.title: v.2.4 - A little patch for the weekend
notes.notes:
Happy weekend, gang! Hope you good folks aren't melting away in the summer heat.
To keep things even hotter, we are ready with our [b]2.4.0[/b] patch.

+ Improved puzzle generation loading times across the board.
+ There is now a Renaming system, so you can rename guests, rooms, activities and toys.
+ New setting allows to force in renamed guests into the puzzle generation.
+ New setting allows for faster endgame sequence.
+ New free unlockable : Welcome Drinks! Trade in some points for easier gameplay. Unlocked for all.
+ Using the number keys 1-8, you can now color-tag the characters. Press 0 to reset.
+ New setting : American-style floor naming.
+ Improved performance on Nvidia graphics cards.
+ Adjusted the difficulty curve a bit in the early stages.
+ More punly puns.
+ Cleared up some memory leaks.
+ Added two new guests.
+ Added two new activities.
+ Added two new toys.

notes.title: Patch 2.1.5: Toggles and typos
notes.notes:
Thanks to good feedback, we have a quick patch with a little patch for you all.

+ New feature: You can now block elements in the collection if you for any reason dislike them. Blocked elements will not spawn in the game.
+ Even more tasty MondSemmel typo fixes.
+ New toy : Catering Table

notes.title: Patch 2.1.4 - Sweet summer
notes.notes:
Hi gang, we are doing some house cleaning and pushed out a new patch of sweet summer goodness.

The patch includes:
+ Multiple typo fixes (a great cheer to MondSemmel for helping pointing them out)
+ A lot of puzzle generation optimization (ideally shorter level bootup time)
+ 1 new unlockable.
+ 3 new unlockable characters.
+ 3 new activities.
+ Fixed some account sync issues that could cause certain scores not to save.
+ Adjusted the spawn balance of certain request types.

I will be doing a NSFW game jam this week plus taking some days off for health reasons, so this is probably the last larger sized patch from me this month.

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - Pumped up for Pride!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Orgynizer 2.0[/b] is Here! Celebrate Pride Month with an Explosive Update[/h1]

We're thrilled to announce the release of[b] Orgynizer 2.0[/b], just in time for Pride Month!
Dive into the ultimate sex-positive puzzle romp where you organize sensational swinger parties, now more fabulous than ever. Here's what’s new in this exciting update:

[*] Optimized some puzzle generation issues.
[*] Expanded the level count to 40!
[*] New postcards backdrops to make level selection more enticing.
[*] New characters.
[*] Couple of new activities.

If you want to chat about the game, feel free to join our Discord server (link is in the main menu), and thank you all so much for your support.

notes.title: Lil' April Update
notes.notes:
Hello all you delicious players out there. Easter has rolled on over, and as warmth is slowly coming back, we felt it was high time to do a little update on Orgynizer.

[h1]Version 1.7 brings:[/h1]

+ Fixed some bugs related to toys.
+ New unlockable: The Field Guide
+ New helpful unlockable: Chocolate
+ New special activity: Cuckolding
+ New innocent toy: Video Game
+ Improved scrolling when the building is outside of screen size.
+ Tweaked building generation script to better fit the screen size.
+ Tweaked guest list placement and scrolling.
+ Increased crash and impossible puzzle safeguards.
+ Fixed some tooltip issues regarding Champagne.
+ Reduced memory consumption on puzzle generation.
+ Minor UI improvements.

[h1]Sidenote : Streamer copystrikes[/h1]

It has come to my attention that some streamers are experiencing copyright strikes on the music we use in the game. ALL music is cleared with the composer, and you should have full rights to play it in your streams. If this happens to you, please write us at orgynizergame@gmail.com and include which song they claim you can't use, and we will help fight it.
